title: Prophetic advice for daily life
subtitle: Sixty pieces of advice from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, that a Muslim needs every day and night

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, God will accept his repentance.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]
content.explanation: Repentance is a daily behavior practiced by a Muslim. The doors of God’s mercy are open through repentance. The Almighty said: And God desires to be in repentance to you. [Surat An-Nisa: Verse 27] Repent for every sin, and there is no path you take to God except the path of repentance.

content.intro: One scholar is more powerful against Satan than a thousand worshipers
content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever follows a path seeking knowledge, God will make easy for him a path to Paradise.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: When you leave your house and go to a gathering of knowledge, you increase your knowledge. This path that you take is a path to Paradise. If you want this world, you must have knowledge, and if you want the afterlife, you must have knowledge, and if you want both, you must have knowledge.

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Darda, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, the highest in your ranks, the purest in the eyes of your King, better for you than paper and gold, and better for you than meeting your enemy and striking their necks, and them striking your necks? They said: Yes, he said: Remembrance of God
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: If you read the Qur’an, you are a remembrancer, and if you ask for forgiveness, then you are a remembrancer, and if you communicate with God, then you are a remembrancer, and if you think about God’s creatures, then you are a remembrancer, and any activity that brings you closer to God Almighty is a form of remembrance.

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Dharr, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Do not despise any act of kindness, even if it is to meet your brother with a cheerful face.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.intro: A person does not regret when the angel of death comes to him, except for a good deed that he failed to perform, so he says, peace and blessings be upon him
content.hadith: Every favor is charity, and it is good to meet your brother with a cheerful face, and to empty your bucket into your brother’s vessel.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]

content.intro: The call to God is an individual obligation. Have you not listened to an explanation of a verse during your science lessons? To explain a hadith? To the position of a companion? To a jurisprudential ruling? He says, peace and blessings be upon him
content.hadith: Convey from me even if it is a verse
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: Calling to God is an individual obligation for every Muslim, within the limits of what he knows, and with whom he knows
content.additionalNarrator: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، أن رسولَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال
content.additionalHadith: مَنْ دعا إلى هُدىً، كان له من الأجرِ مِثْلُ أجور مَنْ تَبِعَهُ، لا ينقصُ ذلك من أجورهم شيئاً، ومن دعا إلى ضَلالَة، كان عليه من الإثمِ مِثْلُ آثام من تَبِعَهُ، لا يَنْقُص ذلك من أوزارهم شيئاً
content.additionalSource: [ حديث صحيح، أخرجه مسلم والترمذي وأبو داود ]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Saeed Al-Khudri, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand, and if he is unable, then with his tongue, and if he is unable, then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith.
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Umamah Al-Bahili, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: Recite the Qur’an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions. Recite the two verses: Al-Baqarah and Al Imran, for they will come on the Day of Resurrection as if they were two clouds, or two clouds, or as if they were two flocks of birds in flight, arguing on behalf of their companion. Recite Surat Al-Baqarah, for if he takes it, it is a blessing. He left her out of grief, and the heroine cannot do that
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Othman bin Affan, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: The best of you are those who learn and teach the Qur’an
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari, Al-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]

content.narrator: On the authority of Othman bin Affan, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: The best of you are those who learn and teach the Qur’an
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari, Al-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
content.explanation: Reading it is one thing, teaching its rulings, and explaining its verses is another thing

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: By the One in whose hand is my soul, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something that if you did it, you would love one another? Spread peace among you
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim, Abu Dawud and Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: God Almighty will say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who love one another for the sake of My Majesty? Today I will shade them in My shade, a day when there will be no shade but My shade
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Ali bin Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: There is no Muslim who visits a sick Muslim in the morning except that seventy thousand angels will pray over him until the evening, and if he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels will pray over him until the morning, and he will have a fall in Paradise.
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Abu Dawud and Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: To visit a sick person, to comfort him, to make his heart good, to comfort him in his time, to remind him of a verse or hadith, to help him be patient, for this there is a great reward.

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever makes things easy for someone in difficulty, God will make things easy for him in this world and the hereafter
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim and Ibn Hibban]

advices.title: Tolerance in buying and selling and eliminating

content.narrator: On the authority of Jaber bin Abdullah, may God be pleased with them both, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: May God have mercy on a tolerant man when he sells, when he buys, and when he requires.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]
content.explanation: To make things easy for people who are in distress, it is a great work that God will be pleased with you with

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: No slave covers another slave in this world, but God will cover him on the Day of Resurrection
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]
content.explanation: There is a model of a scandalous human being who catches mistakes, spreads them among people, and takes pleasure in that. The Muslim conceals it, the Muslim conceals it.

content.narrator: On the authority of Aisha, may God be pleased with her, she said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: The womb is attached to the throne, saying: Whoever connects me, God will connect him, and whoever cuts me off, God will cut him off.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said
content.hadith: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was asked about what most causes people to enter Hell? He said: The mouth and the private parts, and he was asked about what most takes people to Paradise. He said: Fear of God and good manners.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abdullah bin Masoud, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: You must be honest, for honesty leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Abu Dawud and Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: Be honest and you will rise before God and people, and a believer does not lie
content.additionalNarrator: عن أبي أمامة الباهلي رضي الله عنه، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
content.additionalHadith: يطبع المؤمن على الخلال كلها، إلا الخيانة والكذب

content.narrator: On the authority of Muadh bin Anas, may God be pleased with him, that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever suppresses his anger and is able to release it, God will choose him from the beautiful fairies on the Day of Resurrection
content.source: [From a hadith narrated by Al-Tabarani in Al-Saghir, in which there is a man who is deluded.]
content.quran: وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
content.explanation: Rather, whoever shouts loudly in the house, his justice will be injured, and the forbearing is almost a prophet, and forbearance is the master of morals.

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever sits in a gathering in which his quarreling abounded, and he says before he gets up from that sitting, Glory be to You, O God, and with Your praise, I bear witness that there is no god but You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You, unless he will be forgiven for what happened in that sitting.
content.source: [Hadith narrated by Al-Tirmidhi with a good chain of transmission]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Saeed and Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with them, that they heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say
content.hadith: No illness, fatigue, sickness, or sadness befalls a believer, or even worry that afflicts him, except that God expiates his bad deeds because of it.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari, Muslim and Al-Tirmidhi]
content.quran: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
content.explanation: Patience is a divine treatment for the believing servant. The one who is patient with God’s treatment of him, this is evidence that he knows God Almighty, just as if an adult sat in the dentist’s chair. He suffers and is thankful, while the little one shouts and may utter a word that is not appropriate for the doctor, because he does not know that this treatment is for his benefit. We need these tips today and tonight.

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said
content.hadith: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: In spite of his nose, in spite of his nose, in spite of his nose. It was said: Who, O Messenger of God? He said: Whoever joins his parents in old age, one or both of them, and then does not enter Paradise.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]
content.explanation: It means that honoring parents is sufficient reason to enter Paradise

advices.title: Striving for the widow and the poor

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: The one who takes care of the widow and the poor is like the one who fights for the sake of God, and I think he said: And like the one who stands up, he does not let up, and like the fasting person who does not break his fast.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
content.explanation: To strive for a widow, to seek for a poor person, then you are like a mujahid in the path of God

content.narrator: On the authority of Sahl bin Saad Al-Saadi, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: I and the one who looks after an orphan will be in Paradise like this. He pointed with his index and middle fingers, and spaced them a little
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari, Al-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]

content.narrator: On the authority of Othman bin Affan, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever performs ablution and performs it well, his sins will leave his body and then come out from under his nails.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Omar bin Al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever performs ablution and performs it well, then says: I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O God, make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves, eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him, and he may enter through whichever one he wishes.
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Jabir, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever says when he hears the call: O God, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, give Muhammad the means and virtue, and raise him to the praiseworthy station which You promised him, my intercession will be granted to him on the Day of Resurrection.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]

content.narrator: On the authority of Omar bin Al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, that he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: Whoever builds a mosque for God in which he will be remembered, God will build for him a house in Paradise
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Ibn Majah and Ahmad]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Were it not to be a hardship for my nation, or for the people, I would have ordered them to use the siwak with every prayer
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever goes to the mosque tomorrow or goes, God will prepare for him a place in Paradise every time he goes tomorrow or goes
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Ibn Khuzaymah]

content.narrator: On the authority of Amr bin Saeed bin Al-Aas, that Othman called for his purification, and said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: There is no Muslim who attends a prescribed prayer and performs its ablution, humility and bowing well, except that it is an expiation for the sins that came before it, unless they are major, and that is for the whole of eternity.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Musa Al-Ash’ari, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever prays Al-Baradain will enter Paradise
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
content.explanation: Al-Bardan: Fajr prayer and afternoon prayer, meaning whoever observes them at their appointed times

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever performs ablution and performs it well, then comes to the Friday prayer and listens and listens, his sins between that time and the Friday prayer, and an additional three days, will be forgiven, and whoever touches the pebble has committed negligence.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned Friday, and said
content.hadith: There is an hour in which a Muslim servant does not agree. He is standing and praying, asking God for something, but He gives it to him, and he gestures with his hand, reducing it.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Umm Habibah, the Mother of the Believers, may God be pleased with her, she said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs, God will build a house for him in Paradise: four rak'ahs before noon, two after it, two rak'ahs before the afternoon, two rak'ahs after sunset, and two rak'ahs before dawn.
content.source: [A hadith narrated by Al-Nasa’i and Ibn Khuzaymah with an authentic chain of transmission]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: The best fasting after Ramadan, God’s month of Muharram, and the best prayer after the obligatory prayers, is the night prayer.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Dhar al-Ghafari, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: It becomes a charity for every greeting of one of you. Every tasbih is a charity, every tahmidah is a charity, every tahlila is a charity, every takbeer is a charity, enjoining what is right is a charity, and forbidding what is evil is a charity, and two rak’ahs that he performs in the forenoon are sufficient for that.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]

advices.title: Prayers be upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him

content.narrator: On the authority of Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas, may God be pleased with them both, that he heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: Whoever sends a prayer upon me, may God bless him ten times
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Muslim]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Saeed, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: There is no servant who fasts a day for the sake of God, except that God will keep his face seventy distances away from Hell.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

advices.title: Fasting three days of every month

content.narrator: On the authority of Jarir bin Abdullah, may God be pleased with them both, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said
content.hadith: Fasting three days of every month, fasting forever
content.source: [A good hadith, narrated by Al-Nasa’i]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it will be like fasting a whole year.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim and Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Zaid bin Khaled Al-Juhani, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever breaks the fast for a fasting person will have a reward similar to his reward, except that it does not detract from the reward of the fasting person in the slightest
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever prays Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]

content.narrator: On the authority of Muadh bin Jabal, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said
content.hadith: Charity extinguishes sin, just as water extinguishes fire
content.source: [From an authentic hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]
content.additionalNarrator: عن أنس رضي الله عنه، أنَّ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال
content.additionalHadith: إن الصدقَةَ تُطْفِئُ غَضَبَ الرَّبِّ، وتَدْفَعُ مِيتَة السُّوءِ

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Umrah to Umrah is an expiation for what comes between them, and the accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

advices.title: Take advantage of the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah

content.narrator: On the authority of Abdullah bin Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: There are no days in which good deeds are more beloved to God than these ten days. They said: O Messenger of God, not even jihad? He said: Not even jihad, except for a man who went out to risk his life and his money, and did not return with anything.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]

advices.title: Jihad for the sake of God

content.narrator: On the authority of Sahl bin Saad, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: A day’s bond in the path of God is better than the world and what is in it, and the place of one of you’s whip in Paradise is better than the world and what is in it, and the soul that a servant takes in the path of God, or the morning, is better than the world and what is in it.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
content.additionalNarrator: عن زيد بن خالد الجهني رضي الله عنه، أن رسولَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال
content.additionalHadith: من جهَّز غازياً في سبيل الله فقد غزَا، ومن خَلَّف غازياً في أهله بخير فقد غزا

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever attends the funeral until the funeral prayer is performed over it gets a Qirat, and whoever witnesses it until it is buried gets two Qirats. It was said: What are the two Qirats? He said: Like two great mountains
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

advices.title: Preserving the tongue and private parts

content.narrator: On the authority of Sahl bin Saad Al-Saadi, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever guarantees for me what is between his legs and what is between his two beards, I guarantee him Paradise.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari and Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: Guarding one’s tongue from lying, backbiting, and gossiping, and guarding one’s chastity as well, are two ways to enter Paradise

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever says: There is no god but God alone, with no partner, to Him belongs dominion, and to Him is praise, and He has power over all things, one hundred times in a day, he will have the equivalent of ten slaves, and one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him, and erased. One hundred bad deeds from him, and it was a protection for him from Satan that day until the evening, and no one brought anything better than what he brought, except a man who did more than him. He said: And whoever says: Glory be to God and praise be to Him a hundred times in a day, it will be deducted. His sins, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari, Muslim, Al-Muwatta’ and Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: I saw a man turning in Paradise, over a tree he cut down from the path of the Muslims, which was harming people.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Muslim]
content.explanation: To remove harm from the road is a great work for God

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Saeed Al-Khudri, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters, or two sisters, and is a good companion to them, and fears God regarding them, will have Paradise.
content.source: [A good hadith, narrated by Abu Dawud and Al-Tirmidhi]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace
content.hadith: A man saw a dog eating dirt out of thirst, so the man took his slippers and scooped them up for him, until he quenched his thirst. Then God thanked him, and he admitted him to Paradise.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Bukhari]
content.explanation: If you do good to an animal, the price is Paradise

content.narrator: On the authority of Anas bin Malik, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said
content.hadith: Shall I not tell you about your men in Paradise? We said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: The Prophet is in Paradise, the friend is in Paradise, the martyr is in Paradise, the newborn is in Paradise, and the man who visits his brother in the region of Egypt does not visit him except for the sake of Allah, in Paradise.
content.source: [From a hadith narrated by Al-Tabarani, its men are the men of Sahih except one]

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Umamah Al-Bahili, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: I guarantee a house in the outskirts of Paradise for the one who abandons quarreling, even if he is right, and a house in the middle of Paradise for the one who abandons lying, even if he is joking, and a house at the top of Paradise for the one who has good character.
content.source: [A hadith narrated by Abu Dawud with an authentic chain of transmission]

advices.title: A woman's obedience to her husband

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: If a woman performs her fifth prayer, fasts her month, guards her chastity, and obeys her husband, she will enter through whichever gates of Paradise she wishes.
content.source: [Sahih hadith, narrated by Al-Tabarani and Ibn Hibban]

content.intro: As long as you are able to serve yourself, do not ask anything from anyone
content.narrator: On the authority of Thawban, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said
content.hadith: Who will guarantee for me that people will not ask anything, and I will guarantee Paradise for him? Thawban said: “I am.” He did not ask anyone anything
content.source: [A hadith narrated by Abu Dawud with an authentic chain of transmission]

advices.title: Two rak'ahs of repentance from sin

content.narrator: On the authority of Abu Bakr, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying
content.hadith: There is no man who commits a sin, then gets up and purifies himself and prays, then asks God for forgiveness except that he will be forgiven.
content.source: [From a good hadith, narrated by Al-Tirmidhi]
content.explanation: Perform ablution, pray two rak’ahs, and ask God for forgiveness in these two rak’ahs, for God Almighty will forgive you that sin.
